verdict.rationale: Algolia's Search API manages individual records in hosted indices, and its docs describe sending data to Algolia, including connector-managed schedules and retries. A community user also synced Firebase data via a single cloud function, which implies incremental record-level updates rather than full reindexes. However, the evidence never explicitly documents per-record add/update/delete operations or how quickly changes become searchable. Missing for 10: explicit docs on partial updates and deletes of individual records, a stated near-real-time indexing latency, and independent or hands-on corroboration of update-to-searchable timing.
